title: Dream
content: ***So I had this dream, actually last night, and actually a couple nights ago too. I am in this, church, I guess im looking for a specific room . I go out the exit, and walk back in, the church room is gone. Now im in a room full of excersise equipment. I leave again go to my left, there is a pool. I walk out again through this room, now back at the sanctuary in the church. Somwhow,when I leave I found myself in a strange park, their are only two little girls, one on swings, the other a merrygo round, old rusted metal kind that squeaks. I have found out not to talk to girls, they just attempt to catch me, and chase me up to the cemetery at the top of the hill, I can go to this playground whenever I want through different times in the day. Than I remember, a different room looking out at an ocean I found a way to it..saw two guys emerging from a stairway, to the sand. I and another, friend tried to warn them of danger. The shops along the board walk were closing, boarded up windows, sand bags. Water was rushing the boards. I went in I guess dining hall, water started spilling through door. I wanted to find my way out, so I asked, I was taken to this road. More buildings on opposite side. I looked both ways, something that others weren't doing, there were no cars on this road. There is so much to this dream, I guess I made it to a bath room it was huge. Pink and white marble, with columns and flowers. A landing which my friend ran to, and introduced the princess, which was me. This place was beyond magnificent.***
